The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tulak Hord]] participated in a '''Kaggath''', a ritual [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] duel against a rival, only once during his lifetime. He was victorious, and declared that the name of his opponent should be erased entirely from history.
